lgb: LGB is a smart bomb that seeks the laser light reflected off of the target and uses it to correct its descent.
For example: "Laser-guided bombs cannot be used in cloudy weather."
LGB means the same as laser-guided bomb.
lgv: LGV is infectious disease caused by a species of chlamydia bacterium.
LGV means the same as lymphogranuloma venereum or lymphopathia venereum.
